subject: Data Engineering
title: Wide Tables and One Big Table
description: A short lesson to help you apply Wide Tables and One Big Table.

hook.text: Some teams skip star schemas entirely and flatten everything into one massive wide table.

buildup.text: A wide table pre-joins all dimensions into the fact table. Every column lives in one place.

discovery.text: No joins at query time means faster dashboards and simpler SQL for analysts.

twist.text: Wide tables duplicate enormous amounts of data and make updates painful across millions of rows.

climax.text: With cheap cloud storage, many teams accept the duplication trade-off for query simplicity.

punchline.text: One big table. Zero joins. Maximum speed.

quiz.question: What is the trade-off of using a single wide table?
options: Faster queries but massive data duplication
